You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact is one line: subject | relation | value | condition (after "if:", when there is one) | the place it
comes from. A long value or condition is shortened and ends with "…"; a normal form (a date, a duration, a short
name) follows the value in brackets when there is one. Some facts carry a note computed from the dates: trust the notes.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with every date in the facts, one by one, before you answer.
  A repeal, a limit or an application "from" a date takes effect on that date, not earlier: an act repealed from a
  date is still fully in force, with everything it permits, on every earlier day; a rule applying from a date does
  not yet bind on earlier days.
- If a note says that a date quoted in a condition was corrected, reason with the corrected date.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the
  facts, one item per fact. Facts filed under the same article, annex part or numbered point belong together.
  When the answer is a group named by an article or an annex part and the facts list the members of that group,
  give the members, not the name of the group.
- A fact noted as "filed under a place the question names" belongs to the answer of a "which / what" question
  about that place whenever its relation fits the question: list all of them, not one.
- Lines under "Computed by rule" are results worked out in code from the numbered facts they name: trust them,
  give their result as the answer for the device asked about, and put the fact numbers they name in "used".
- Include only what the question asks for: no neighbouring item, no other regime that the question did not ask
  about. An option that combines several things in sequence is one item, not several.
- A fact about a neighbouring subject (another paragraph, another device, another kind of verification, another
  product, another deadline) does not answer the question. When the exact subject asked about is absent from the
  facts, "unknown" is the correct answer: do not answer from the nearest fact.
- For a "who" question, when one fact, or several facts with the same subject and relation, name several bodies,
  all of them are the answer together: name each one.
- For "which categories / which items listed in a place", the answer is the members filed under that place, each
  in the words of its fact, without adding the place to the item.
- For "which risks / which hazards does a numbered point address", use every fact filed under that point whatever
  its relation: a measure is required against a risk, and its subject and condition name that risk.
- Never return a list for a "text" answer: a question that one sentence answers (who, why, how, under which
  condition, which one thing and why) gets one short sentence. "Which / what / list all" of several things is "set".
- Facts marked "matched by relation" were found by querying the facts by their relation, subject and place:
  prefer them. When the question asks for all of something, the answer is the list of their subjects or values,
  one item per fact, nothing merged and nothing dropped. If the matched facts answer the question, do not add
  items from the other facts, which are context.
- The kind follows the question: "from which date / when (a day)" is "date"; "for how long" alone is "duration";
  "can / may / is / does" is "boolean"; "which / what (several things)" is "set"; who, why, under which condition,
  or who does something and within what time is "text", and the text names every element asked for.
- Return JSON only, with the reasoning first:
  {"reasoning": "the facts and dates compared, step by step, in a few short sentences",
   "kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Question: Which types of machinery are always subject to a conformity assessment procedure that involves a notified body?

Facts:
[0] EU type-examination | defined as | the part of a conformity assessment procedure in which a notified body… | [REG, Annex VII]
[1] notified body | has obligation | any conformity assessment activities | if: on request | [REG, Art. 40(1)]
[2] notified body | defined as | conformity assessment body notified in accordance with this Regulation | [REG, Art. 3(30)]
[3] notified body identification number affixing | has obligation | shall be affixed by the body itself or, under its instructions… | if: Where the conformity of machinery or a related product is assessed | [REG, Art. 24(3)]
[4] EC type-examination | defined as | the procedure whereby a notified body ascertains and certifies | [DIR, Annex IX]
[5] conformity assessment body, its top-level management and personnel | has obligation | shall not engage in any activity that may conflict with their independence… | if: in relation to conformity assessment activities for which they are notified | [REG, Art. 30(4)]
[6] manufacturer | has obligation | take appropriate corrective actions | if: where, in the course of the monitoring of conformity, a notified body finds that machinery or a related product no longer complies | [REG, Art. 38(4)]
[7] conformity to type based on internal production control | defined as | the part of a conformity assessment procedure | [REG, Annex VIII]
[8] conformity assessment body | has obligation | shall not be the designer, manufacturer, supplier | if: of machinery or related products that they assess; This shall not preclude the use of assessed machinery | [REG, Art. 30(4)]
[9] conformity assessment body | defined as | a body that performs conformity assessment activities | [REG, Art. 3(29)]
[10] conformity assessment body | has obligation | shall participate in, or ensure that its personnel | [REG, Art. 30(11)]
[11] conformity assessment body | has obligation | shall apply as general guidance | [REG, Art. 30(11)]
[12] conformity assessment body | has obligation | shall not be directly involved in the design | [REG, Art. 30(4)]
[13] manufacturers | has obligation | carry out the relevant conformity assessment procedure referred to in Article 25… | if: Before placing machinery or a related product on the market or putting it into service | [REG, Art. 10(2)]
[14] CE marking | has obligation | must be followed by the identification number of the notified body | if: Where the full quality assurance procedure referred to in Article 12(3)(c) and 12(4)(b) has been applied | [DIR, Annex III]
[15] machinery or related product substantially modified | requires procedure | conformity assessment procedure as provided in Article 25 (2), (3) and (4) | [REG, Art. 18]
[16] machinery and related products in categories listed in Annex I, Part B | requires procedure | specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(3) | [REG, Art. 6(1)]
[17] machinery and related products in categories listed in Annex I, Part A | requires procedure | specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(2) | [REG, Art. 6(1)]
[18] conformity assessment body | has obligation | shall ensure that the activities of its subsidiaries | [REG, Art. 30(4)]
[19] manufacturer or his authorised representative | has obligation | shall apply the procedure (shall apply the procedure for assessment of conformity) | if: Where the machinery is not referred to in Annex IV | [DIR, Art. 12(2)]
[20] notified body | defined as | Only such a body shall be considered a notified body | if: for the purposes of this Regulation | [REG, Art. 34(5)]
[21] conformity assessment body | has obligation | shall take out liability insurance | if: unless liability is assumed by the Member State in accordance with national law… | [REG, Art. 30(9)]
[22] notified body | has obligation | any circumstances affecting the scope of | [REG, Art. 40(1)]
[23] personnel of a conformity assessment body | has obligation | shall observe professional secrecy | if: except in relation to the competent authorities of the Member State in which its tasks are carried out | [REG, Art. 30(10)]
[24] manufacturer | has obligation | take appropriate corrective actions | if: Where a notified body finds that the essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III… | [REG, Art. 38(3)]
[25] manufacturer | has obligation | shall inform the notified body | [DIR, Annex X]
[26] machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B | requires procedure | conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) | if: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B | [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[27] applicant | has obligation | shall inform the notified body which retains the technical file | [DIR, Annex IX]
[28] notified body | has obligation | shall ensure that a transparent and accessible appeals procedure | [REG, Art. 39]
[29] notified body | has obligation | shall inform the notifying authority | [REG, Art. 40(1)]
[30] notified body | has obligation | any refusal, restriction, suspension or withdrawal | [REG, Art. 40(1)]
[31] internal production control | defined as | the conformity assessment procedure whereby the manufacturer fulfils the obligations | [REG, Annex VI]
[32] importers | has obligation | shall ensure that the appropriate conformity assessment procedures | if: Before placing machinery or a related product on the market | [REG, Art. 13(2)]
[33] notified body | has obligation | any request for information | [REG, Art. 40(1)]
[34] applicant | has obligation | shall place at the disposal of the notified body a sample of… | [DIR, Annex IX]
[35] manufacturer or the natural or legal person referred to in Article 18 | has obligation | shall apply one of the conformity assessment procedures | [REG, Art. 25(1)]
[36] machinery referred to in Annex IV | requires procedure | EC type-examination procedure | if: provided that those standards cover all of the relevant essential health and safety requirements | [DIR, Art. 12(3)]
[37] category of machinery or related product | requires procedure | EU type-examination (module B) set out in Annex VII… (module B followed by module C) | if: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A | [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[38] EU declaration of incorporation | has obligation | shall include a sentence declaring the conformity with such acts | if: Where partly completed machinery is subject to more than one Union legal act requiring an EU declaration of conformity | [REG, Art. 22(3)]
[39] copy of EU type-examination certificate, annexes, additions and technical file kept by notified body | retention period | for a period of five years (P5Y) | [REG, Annex VII, 7]
[40] conformity assessment | defined as | means the process for demonstrating | [REG, Art. 3(28)]
[41] machinery referred to in Annex IV | requires procedure | the EC type-examination procedure provided for in Annex IX | if: Where the machinery is referred to in Annex IV and has not been manufactured in accordance with the harmonised standards referred to in Article… | [DIR, Art. 12(4)]
[42] periodic audits | verified by | The notified body | [DIR, Annex X]
[43] machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B | requires procedure | conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) | if: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B | [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[44] manufacturers | has obligation | draw up the EU declaration of conformity in accordance with Article 21 | if: Where compliance of machinery or a related product with the essential health and safety requirements laid down in Annex III has been demonstrated by… | [REG, Art. 10(2)]
[45] EU declaration of incorporation | has obligation | shall contain the identification of the Union legal acts concerned | if: Where partly completed machinery is subject to more than one Union legal act requiring an EU declaration of conformity | [REG, Art. 22(3)]
[46] machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B | requires procedure | EU type-examination (module B) | if: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B | [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[47] category of machinery or related product | requires procedure | conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) set out in Annex… (module H) | if: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A | [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[48] machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B | requires procedure | conformity based on unit verification (module G) | if: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B | [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[49] category of machinery or related product | requires procedure | conformity based on unit verification (module G) set out in Annex X (module G) | if: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A | [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[50] manufacturer | has obligation | shall lodge an application | [REG, Annex VII, 3]
[51] copy of EU type-examination certificate, annexes, additions and technical documentation kept by manufacturer | retention period | for at least 10 years (P10Y) | if: after the machinery or related product has been placed on the market or put into service | [REG, Annex VII, 7]
[52] manufacturer's authorised representative | has obligation | fulfil the obligations set out in points 7.2, 7.4 and 9 | if: provided that they are specified in the mandate | [REG, Annex VII, 7]
[53] manufacturer | has obligation | The manufacturer shall take all measures necessary | [REG, Annex VIII, 2]
[54] manufacturer's obligations set out in point 3 | has obligation | may be fulfilled by its authorised representative | if: provided that they are specified in the mandate | [REG, Annex VIII, 4]
[55] verifiche periodiche delle attrezzature dell'Allegato VII | verified by | personale specializzato dell’ASP di competenza o Organismo privato riconosciuto | if: Per particolari attrezzature, il cui utilizzo comporta pericoli particolari e riportate nell’Allegato VII | [unict-guideline, p. 1]
[56] datore di lavoro (punti 1 e 2) | has obligation | si ritengono assolti con la procedura omologativa | if: Per le attrezzature sopra elencate, prive di marcatura CE8 e non oggetto di mo- difiche sostanziali | [inail-guide, p. 35]
[57] richiesta di verifica periodica successiva | verified by | Azienda sanitaria nazionale (Asl) o Agenzia regionale protezione ambientale (Arpa) o soggetti… (VerifyingBody) | [inail-guide, p. 39]
[58] manufacturer of the machinery | has obligation | carry out a risk assessment | [nanoscan3-manual, p. 21]
[59] idroestrattori | has obligation | il datore di lavoro dovrà attestare la conformità della macchina ai requisiti… | if: Per gli idroestrattori privi di marcatura CE | [inail-guide, p. 27]
[60] integrator | integrator responsible for | Always conduct an application risk assessment for foreseeable risks and reasonably foreseeable… | [ur10e-manual, p. 185]
[61] integrator | integrator responsible for | Always conduct an application risk assessment for foreseeable risks and reasonably foreseeable… | [ur5e-manual, p. 182]
[62] verifiche di cui all’art.71 comma 11 D.Lgs. 81/2008 | verified by | soggetti abilitati | [igea-equipment, p. 4]
[63] impianto | has declaration | dichiarazione di conformità | [inail-guide, p. 17]
[64] macchina non conforme | has obligation | la macchina non potrà essere utilizzata fino all’adozione delle misure necessarie atte… | if: Qualora la non conformità sia di pregiudizio per la sicurezza dei lavoratori | [univpm-guideline, p. 8]
[65] manufacturer | has obligation | shall transmit relevant information | if: in response to a reasoned request by the national authorities | [ur10e-manual, p. 227]
[66] verifica periodica degli apparecchi di sollevamento | verified by | soggetti abilitati pubblici o privati | [igea-equipment, p. 3]
[67] macchina non conforme | put into service only when | la macchina non potrà essere utilizzata fino all’adozione delle misure necessarie atte… | if: Qualora la non conformità sia di pregiudizio per la sicurezza dei lavoratori | [unict-guideline, p. 2]
[68] soggetti abilitati | has obligation | devono essere in possesso dei requisiti | [DM2011, art. 2, c. 2]
[69] aggiudicatario | has obligation | Comunicare il nominativo del verificatore incaricato | [igea-equipment, p. 5]
[70] datore di lavoro | has obligation | installate ed utilizzate in conformità alle istruzioni d’uso | [unict-guideline, p. 17]

response.text: {"reasoning": "Fact [17] says machinery and related products in categories listed in Annex I, Part A require the specific procedures in Article 25(2). Fact [37] shows that for Part A the procedure is EU type-examination (module B, defined in [0] as involving a notified body) followed by module C. Part B (facts [16], [26], [43], [46], [48]) includes module C, which is internal production control and involves no notified body, so Part B is not always subject to notified-body assessment. Today's date does not affect the answer because no date condition is attached.", "kind": "set", "value": ["machinery and related products in categories listed in Annex I, Part A"], "text": "Machinery and related products in the categories listed in Annex I, Part A always require an Article 25(2) procedure involving a notified body, under Annex VII (module B followed by module C). This is stated in Article 6(1) and Article 25(2).", "used": [17, 37, 0]}
